consumer: mission::is_complete for MGOAL_FIND_ITEM, asking 'does the player possess the required count of the part?' to mark the fetch mission complete
scope: items reachable for the mission check: the player's crafting_inventory() (carried plus nearby reachable items), NOT carried-only
decisive_source: src/mission.cpp::mission::is_complete (MGOAL_FIND_ITEM) -- its body evaluates u.crafting_inventory().has_amount(item_id, item_count) (with a charges fallback) and returns the yes/no that completes the mission
divergence: the required part lies on the ground one tile from the player (inside crafting_inventory() reach) but is not wielded/worn/in inventory: mission::is_complete returns true, while a carried-only possession check (visit_items / u_has_items) returns false -- exposing a wrong-scope authority
